Unless otherwise stated, each problem is worth 4 points. Show all
of your work.

\emph{Evaluate the following integrals.}
\begin{enumerate}
\item {[}6 pts{]}${\displaystyle \int\ln3x\,dx}$\vfill\vspace{-3cm}
\item ${\displaystyle \int}\sin^{2}3x\,dx$\vfill
\item ${\displaystyle \int\cos^{3}x\,dx}$\vfill\newpage
\item ${\displaystyle \int\sin^{2}x}\cos^{2}x\,dx$\vfill
\item ${\displaystyle \int\cos^{3}x}\sin x\,dx$\vfill\newpage
\item {[}6 pts{]}${\displaystyle \int\frac{dx}{\sqrt{4-x^{2}}}}$\vfill\vspace{-2.5cm}
\item {[}8 pts{]}${\displaystyle \int_{0}^{4}\sqrt{16-x^{2}}\,dx}$\vfill
\item {[}2 pts{]}${\displaystyle \int\sqrt{16-x^{2}}}\,dx$; hint: use the
reference triangle and the double-angle identity, $\sin2\theta=2\sin\theta\cos\theta$.\vfill\vspace{-2cm}
\end{enumerate}
